en-US.name: Replay Court
en-US.summary: Clip plays and export a highlight reel from the Replay app on your Fire TV.
en-US.description: Replay Court talks to the Replay app on your Fire TV. Pair it once with the code your TV shows, then say "clip that" while you watch a game, or ask for a highlight reel and scan the code on the TV to get it on your phone.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask replay court to clip that
Alexa, ask replay court to export a highlight reel
Alexa, ask replay court to pair code 4829

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development stage only (hackathon demo). Pair with the 4-digit code from Replay's Settings > Pair with Alexa on the Fire TV.
